notes:
Operator: RMTC Goiania (Rede Metropolitana de Transporte Coletivo), governed by CMTC, operated by RedeMob consorcio (Eixo Anhanguera BRT corridor itself operated by Metrobus under Goias state concession). Timezone America/Sao_Paulo.

WHAT IS BUILT (2 routes, both directions each):
- Route 117 "Eixo Anhanguera / T. Pe. Pelagio / T. Novo Mundo": the BRT trunk corridor. Full 18-station ordered sequence taken from CittaMobi published stop list for line 117 (Novo Mundo <-> Praca da Biblia <-> Praca A <-> Dergo <-> Padre Pelagio), which matches the Wikipedia/Metrobus corridor description (5 integration terminals + 13 stations). Real published service: weekdays 03:45-21:30, ~10 min headway; I emit one representative trip per direction at 06:00 with 2 min/station spacing (realistic BRT dwell). route_type=3 (BRT classed as bus).
- Route 002 "Parque Atheneu / Centro / Rodoviaria": trunk feeder. Only terminal-level endpoints are evidenced by the aggregators (Parque Atheneu origin, Praca Civica/Centro, Terminal Isidoria), so this route has just 3 stops per direction. Real published span weekdays 05:00-23:10; one representative trip per direction at 05:00.

COORDINATES (WGS-84): Terminals TNM, TBIB, TPRA, TPP and Praca Civica geocoded directly from OSM/Nominatim (confirmed). Terminal Dergo (Setor Rodoviario) approximated on-corridor. The 13 intermediate BRT stations are NOT individually geocodable, so they are linearly interpolated along Av. Anhanguera between the confirmed terminal anchors -- the corridor is a straight median so cross-track error is small (tens of meters). Parque Atheneu and Terminal Isidoria coords are approximate neighborhood/terminal centroids (Nominatim was 429-throttled before I could confirm them).

CONFIDENCE 0.45 rationale: The corridor route (117) station list + ordering + operating window are well-evidenced and faithful; terminal coords are exact. But (a) intermediate station coords are interpolated not surveyed, (b) exact per-trip clock times are synthesized from the published headway rather than a real trip table, (c) only 2 of ~276 RMTC lines are represented -- the aggregator sources (onibus.online, horariodeonibus.net, official rmtcgoiania.com.br which is JS-rendered) expose line lists and schedule windows but NOT full ordered stop sequences with the ~7,024 physical stops, so an all-lines feed was not supportable from these sources. This is a faithful skeleton of the highest-ridership BRT corridor plus one trunk line, not the full network.

SOURCES: CittaMobi line-117 stop list; pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eixo_Anhanguera; goias.gov.br/metrobus terminal list; onibus.online RMTC line directory + line 002 schedule; OSM/Nominatim for coordinates. Calendar covers 2026; Eixo Anhanguera corridor is weekday-focused (WKDY), line 002 runs daily (DAILY).
